verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product: it reviews PRs and local changes, generates targeted fixes, writes PR descriptions and produces wikis. Generating a whole working app from a sketch, image or PDF design is an app-builder capability outside the code-review category. Nothing in the evidence shows cubic ships design-to-app generation, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
